offers_products.reason: Sells IoT telematics devices, sensors and software platforms (Unity, Pointer, Cellocator) for fleet and asset tracking.

offers_services.reason: Offers SaaS subscriptions, data services, installation and managed IoT services alongside hardware, a main part of the business.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are fleet operators, logistics firms and industrial companies; some insurance telematics, but not primarily households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to fleet operators, enterprises, logistics, manufacturers, and insurers for vehicle and asset tracking.

recurring_revenue.reason: Majority of revenue is recurring SaaS and subscription services for connected fleets and assets.

cyclical_demand.reason: Subscription tracking and fleet-management software is operationally embedded; hardware new deployments may slow, but recurring base is stable.

big_ticket.reason: Devices and subscriptions are small per-unit, recurring purchases, though large deployments occur.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for IoT hardware, software platform and data, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large enterprises, such as big fleets, logistics firms, OEMs and large retailers, plus government.

asset_heavy.reason: Designs devices with outsourced manufacturing and cloud software; growth does not need heavy plant or fleet investment.
